title: VeloraOS 1.10.42 - Runtime Context & Global Memory
releaseNotes: Disables all Chat completion and failure notifications; Chat errors remain visible inline.
Adds trusted current date, weekday, local time, browser timezone and locale to every real model turn.
Adds optional per-user Global Memory stored locally on the VeloraOS appliance across all chats.
Replaces the broken multipart repair with a deterministic gzip payload whose individual parts and decoded archive are all checksum verified.
The updater now prints service status and recent VeloraOS logs automatically if the post-update health check fails.
